text: なにごとにも　きょうみを　もつことが　たいせつ　じゃぞ

structure.jp: きょうみを　もつことが

patterns.name: 〜こと (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: こと after an action word turns the action into a thing you can talk about. きょうみを　もつこと = 'taking an interest'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man だ, 'it is', and ぞ adds force. たいせつ　じゃぞ = 'it's important, I tell you'.
